admin.prefixes_help: A short coloured label before a discussion's title, chosen when it is started. Drag to change the order they are offered in.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete the prefix "{prefix}"? Discussions that have it keep their titles and lose the label.
admin.preview_title: How it looks before a discussion title
admin.slug_help: Used in the filter link, e.g. /?prefix=rumor. Changing it breaks links people have already shared.
admin.icon_help: A Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-bullhorn. Leave empty for none.
admin.tags_label: Tags it can be used in
admin.tags_help: Choose none to offer it everywhere.
admin.staff_only_help: Only members with the "Use staff-only prefixes" permission may apply it — for prefixes like Official.
admin.required_help: Starting a discussion in any of these tags needs a prefix. (Only when the member has a prefix they're allowed to choose there.)

api.not_allowed_here: The prefix {prefix} can't be used in this discussion's tags.
api.required: Choose a prefix for a discussion in this tag.
api.invalid_name: Give the prefix a name of up to 60 characters.
api.invalid_color: Choose a colour as a hex code, e.g. #2563eb.
api.invalid_icon: An icon is a Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-bullhorn.
api.invalid_slug: Give the prefix a link name of letters, numbers and dashes.
api.slug_taken: Another prefix already uses that link name.
